description: This file contains the implementation of various Orleans grains related to streaming, including producer and consumer grains, observer classes, and utility classes for testing streaming behaviors within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: StreamItem
classes.description: A data class representing items transmitted over streams, containing a string data and a stream GUID.

classes.name: ConsumerObserver
classes.description: An observer class implementing IAsyncObserver and IConsumerObserver for consuming stream items, managing stream subscription lifecycle, and logging events.

classes.name: ProducerObserver
classes.description: An observer class implementing IProducerObserver for producing stream items sequentially, in parallel, periodically, and managing associated timers and stream lifecycle.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages a list of producer observers, providing methods to start/stop producing series, handle state persistence, and control lifecycle.

classes.name: PersistentStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: A persistent grain subclass that maintains producer state across activations, extending Streaming_ProducerGrain with state management.

classes.name: Streaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing a set of consumer observers, dedicated to consuming streams, managing subscription lifecycle, and reporting consumption metrics.

classes.name: PersistentStreaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A persistent grain subclass that maintains consumer state across activations, extending Streaming_ConsumerGrain with state management.

classes.name: Streaming_Reentrant_ProducerConsumerGrain
classes.description: A specialized producer-consumer grain that supports reentrant execution model, primarily for testing reentrant stream consumption.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing both producer and consumer roles, coordinating stream production and consumption within a single grain.

classes.name: Streaming_ImplicitlySubscribedConsumerGrainBase
classes.description: A base class for grains that subscribe implicitly to streams using attributes and handle subscription management and events.

methods.name: <All methods in the classes>
methods.description: Individual method descriptions are embedded within each class. Key methods include subscription management, stream production and consumption, verification, deactivation, and lifecycle control.
